method: Real UI interactions in fresh profiles, no injected business state or edited images. Fictional supplier-item metadata, orders, invoice decisions and branch requests are entered through authorized forms. A controlled browser clock clears expired toasts. Headless window.print is suppressed while page.pdf exports the actual operational print portals; this does not validate a physical printer.
